scope.summary: Three follow-ups from the support escalation discussion — one is research (look up how peers handle the issue), one is implementation (ship the fix), one is post-incident memory hygiene (extract lessons learned into the memory store).

proposedTasks.title: Research how peers handle webhook retry semantics for partial failures
acceptanceCriteria: Note their backoff curves and dead-letter behaviour

proposedTasks.title: Implement webhook retry with exponential backoff + DLQ for /webhooks/intake
acceptanceCriteria: Failed-after-N goes to DLQ with surfaced error context

proposedTasks.title: Extract lessons learned from the outage into pending memory items
acceptanceCriteria: Surface the failure pattern, the root cause, and the mitigation as separate memory candidates
Mark them suggestedLayer: domain (delivery semantics is a how-we-do-X fact)

expected.rubric: Pass when the markdown plan keeps all 3 tasks AND the 'Suggested assignee:' lines route correctly by function: task 1 (research) -> Scout, task 2 (implementation) -> Engineer, task 3 (memory extraction) -> Memory Keeper. Allow case-insensitive matching on agent names. Score 1.0 if all 3 are right, 0.66 if 2 of 3 are right, 0.33 if 1 of 3, 0.0 otherwise.
